title: Adjustable Height Freestanding Makeup Mirror - 8-Inch Double-Sided 2X/1X Solid Brass, Allied Brass
body_html:
Get a clearer, steadier view for daily makeup and shaving at your bathroom vanity—backed by a lifetime warranty. This freestanding, adjustable-height make-up mirror features double-sided glass with 2X magnification on one side and 1X on the other for quick, confident grooming.

  • See fine details fast with a 2X magnifying side for close-up grooming
  • Flip to the 1X side for an all-around check at any angle
  • Keep your counter stable and uncluttered with a freestanding design (no wall mounting)
  • Enjoy a steadier setup—the heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
  • Protect your vanity surface with a felt pad that helps prevent scratching

Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives, making this mirror a lasting addition to traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.
